description: The bar chart illustrates the average JGA score for LLaMA-7B and T5-small across 26 turns in a continual dialogue state tracking task. The horizontal axis represents the turn ID, ranging from 0 to 26, while the vertical axis indicates the average JGA score, ranging from 0 to 1. The chart includes two sets of bars, with LLaMA-7B represented by orange bars and T5-small by yellow bars. The LLaMA-7B bars generally show higher scores than the T5-small bars, with the highest score for LLaMA-7B being close to 1 and the lowest being around 0.3. The T5-small bars also show a decreasing trend, with the highest score being around 0.9 and the lowest around 0.2. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars.
